qs.q: Which process describes the action of Joseph Lister in the history of medical microbiology?
o: Formulating the fundamental postulates for infectious disease causality
Isolating the specific bacterium responsible for causing human tuberculosis
Pioneering antiseptic surgery using carbolic acid on instruments and wounds
Disproving spontaneous generation and introducing pasteurization processes
qs.e: Joseph Lister pioneered antiseptic surgery by utilizing carbolic acid to sterilize wounds and surgical instruments, validating germ theory clinically. Robert Koch isolated Mycobacterium tuberculosis and created postulates for disease causality.
